input.subject: 8 Brindlefern Walk – smoke alarm and sockets (ref R/030)
input.body:
Dear Ms Quill,

Re: 8 Brindlefern Walk, Oakhollow, ZZ1 1ZZ – ref R/030

Your landlord has told us he completed the work himself on 31 August. Before we update our records, could you please confirm:

1. Is a smoke alarm now fitted on the upstairs landing, and does it sound when you press its test button? Is the opening in the ceiling covered?
2. You reported several plug sockets coming away from the wall. Are all of them now firmly fixed? If any are still loose, which rooms are they in?

Until we hear back, please don't use any socket that is still loose or moves when you plug something in. If you see scorch marks, smell burning or get a shock, stop using it and call us straight away.

We will check back with you on 9 September if we haven't heard from you.

Kind regards,
Donna
Northbridge Lettings

input.subject: 8 Brindlefern Walk – smoke alarm and sockets (ref R/030)
input.body:
Dear Mr Rusk,

Re: 8 Brindlefern Walk, Oakhollow, ZZ1 1ZZ – ref R/030

Thank you for letting us know about the work. We have noted on the property record that you report the upstairs landing smoke alarm was replaced on 31 August with a 10-year alarm.

Before we close the job, we are asking the tenant to confirm the alarm is working. To complete our compliance record, could you please send the make and model of the new alarm, or a photo of it fitted?

The tenant reported several sockets coming away from the wall. Your email mentions the back-bedroom socket and the kitchen socket you fixed on 5 August. Have any other sockets been checked? If more than these two are affected, we would recommend asking a qualified electrician to check them, and we would be happy to arrange this with your approval.

Kind regards,
Donna
Northbridge Lettings
